claims.claim: KLA fiscal Q4 2026 revenue reached $3.658B versus $3.175B a year earlier; management said AI infrastructure expansion and rising foundry/logic, memory and advanced-packaging complexity are increasing process-control demand.

factors.name: process-control bottleneck exposure
factors.basis: rising device complexity increases inspection/metrology intensity

risks.risk: Semiconductor capital spending cycles and export restrictions can interrupt otherwise structural process-control demand.

causalEdges.from: smaller features and advanced packaging complexity
causalEdges.mechanism: tighter process windows require more measurement and defect control
causalEdges.falsifier: process-control intensity or KLA share falls despite rising device complexity

claims.claim: KLA Q4 FY2026 GAAP net income was $1.363B on $3.658B revenue, versus $1.203B on $3.175B revenue a year earlier; full-year revenue was $13.579B.

factors.name: execution and earnings conversion
factors.basis: revenue growth accompanied higher net income and record-scale annual revenue

risks.risk: High profitability can amplify expectations and valuation sensitivity if WFE growth normalizes.

causalEdges.mechanism: high-value inspection/metrology systems and services convert fab complexity into recurring and product revenue
causalEdges.falsifier: earnings growth decouples negatively from sustained process-control demand

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation conclusion is asserted.
